thread:
anika: FYI daily invoice scan flagged ~11% of March GPU spend (~$22.4k) landing in 'batch-rt' without team tags. Need an owner so we can allocate before we close books.
ron: can you paste a few job ids so infra can track?
anika: samples: btch-9f21, btch-9f22, btch-9f99. Query I ran: `bq query --use_legacy_sql=false 'SELECT job_id, project, labels, cost, region FROM billing.gpu_usage WHERE job_id IN ("btch-9f21","btch-9f22","btch-9f99")'`
infra-bot: Alert: Invoice_2026_03_UNTAGGED -> Ungrouped GPU: $22,401. Suggested: `run backfill_tags_v1` or `snooze_alert(24h)`. To backfill: `/backfill backfill_tags_v1 btch-9f*`.
maya: I can run the backfill but note these rows include both GCP(europe-west1) and AWS(us-east-1). Backfill must set `team`, `cloud.provider`, and `cloud.region` labels.
ops: also we should gate job creation in the pool. I'll open an infra-policy PR to require `team` label on job submit for pool=batch-rt.
finance-lead: temporary ask approved: increase budget alert for pool=batch-rt from $15k -> $30k for 72h to quiet alerts while we reconcile. finance-bot, please apply.
infra-bot: Action taken: budget threshold updated to $30,000 for 72h (requested by @finance-lead). Alert snoozed for 72h.
maya: backfill started (task id: backfill-20260323-12). I'll post results. ETA ~30-60m depending on shards.
anika: once backfill finishes please export 50-record sample for manual check. command: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://atlas.internal/api/billing/export?limit=50&filter=job:btch-9f*"` drop in #finance when done.
ops: tentative owner = infra-costs (contact @ops). @ops please confirm and add to team budget matrix.
ops: confirming ownership. will add infra-costs to matrix and follow up with PR for submit-time validation. ETA EOD tomorrow.
maya: backfill done: 5,103 rows updated, 2 rows failed (permission error on one legacy project). Uploaded sample and backfill log to recon doc: https://docs.internal/recon/batch-rt-untagged
anika: verified sample, failures seem isolated to legacy project `legacy-az`. I'll open a ticket to patch that project's export permissions.
finance-lead: if invoice needs manual adjustment after verification, file ticket to billing@redwood with reference Invoice_2026_03 and include reconciliation sheet link.
ops: created infra-policy PR: require `team` label for pool=batch-rt, added pre-submit validator. link: https://git.internal/infra/PR/4921
anika: great. tagging this resolved for now. will re-open if anything else shows up in next scan. :white_check_mark:
